lead_fa: Shadow Priest ترکیبی از دمیج مستقیم و DoT است که با منبع واحد [[Insanity]] کار می‌کند و خرج‌کنندهٔ اصلی‌اش [[Shadow Word: Madness]] است؛ اپتایم بالای این اسپل با [[Mastery: Shadow Weaving]] دمیجت را بالا می‌برد. دو مسیر Hero Tree داری: [[Archon]] که حول [[Halo]] می‌چرخد و در همهٔ محتواها به‌مراتب قوی‌تر است، و [[Voidweaver]] که با [[Void Torrent]] جان [[Mind Blast]] را به [[Void Blast]] تبدیل می‌کند. بازی اسپک حول پنجره‌های برست هر یک دقیقه با کول‌داون‌های روی‌هم‌چیده می‌سازد.

strengths: Incredibly potent spread cleave that finds use in high end content, where most specs only cleave around their main target
Highly efficient single target: losing effectively nothing to hit additional targets
Strong self-healing against constant rot or ticking damage
Empowers allies' damage as well as its own
weaknesses: Damage outside cooldowns, especially while cleaving, requires standing still
Lacks powerful mobility choices and the ability to kite
Single target is currently quite poor; relies on additional targets for meaningful overall damage

buffs: Void Volley no longer has a cooldown and instead has multiple charges
Ancient Madness now increases Haste and provides significantly more Voidform extension
Improved Voidform now increases the number of Void Volley charges provided by Voidform
New talent Shadeburst replaces Phantom Menace, causing apparitions to deal cleave damage

hero.recommendation: Archon currently performs significantly better than Voidweaver in all forms of content. Archon focuses on Halo to buff yourself and weaken foes, with talents interacting with Voidform and Dark Ascension. Voidweaver uses Void Torrent to channel the power of the Void and transforms Mind Blast into Void Blast. In Mythic+ Voidweaver appears only as a high-key (+20s) niche alternative per the talent page.
hero.archon: Halo keystone: generates resources and procs through Manifested Power and Sustained Potency; extends Voidform via Sustained Potency and Ancient Madness; plays as many Idol talents as possible, leverages Void Apparitions and Shadowy Apparitions.
hero.voidweaver: Void Torrent transforms Mind Blast into Void Blast; high M+ build swaps Misery for Invoked Nightmare for the highest dungeon keys.
hero.comparison_source_note: Wowhead overview (EllipsisPriest, updated 2026-10-13): Archon performs significantly better than Voidweaver in all forms of content; Mythic+ talent page adds Voidweaver for +20 keys.

builds.codes_source: Wowhead Best Shadow Priest Talent Tree Builds page (wowhead.com/guide/classes/priest/shadow/talent-builds-pve-dps), export strings captured verbatim from the page's /talent-calc/blizzard/ links on 2026-10-27; do not modify. The page lists four modes per hero: Single Target, Raid Cleave, Mythic+, Delves (the Delves row shares the Mythic+ code for both heroes).
builds.notes: Archon Raid plays as many Idol talents as possible and leverages Void Apparitions and Shadowy Apparitions; on encounters with add spawns or cleave damage, replace Spectral Horrors with Psychic Link. Archon Mythic+ uses Misery and is recommended for most players in mid-range dungeons. Voidweaver High M+ (for +20s) uses Invoked Nightmare instead of Misery. Delves uses Archon with crowd control tools.

concepts: Maximize Shadow Word: Madness uptime: Insanity is the only resource; keep it from capping at 100 (150 with Voidtouched talented) since uptime increases damage through Mastery: Shadow Weaving
Keep abilities on cooldown: prioritize shorter cooldown spells over longer ones to avoid losing uses across an encounter
React to procs: Mind Devourer and Shadowy Insight must be spent as they occur to avoid wasting casts
Shadow operates on a single resource system with a single hard-hitting spender
AoE cleaves evenly off a single priority target using Tentacle Slam and Psychic Link
Movement tools: cast Tentacle Slam, Shadow Word: Death, or Shadow Word: Pain to generate Insanity and deal damage while moving
st_priority: Cast Shadow Word: Pain if Shadow Word: Pain is not active
Maintain Vampiric Touch, either with Tentacle Slam or hard cast
Spend Insanity on Shadow Word: Madness if it is not active, about to fall off, or you are about to cap
Cast Mind Flay: Insanity if Shadow Word: Madness is active
Cast Shadow Word: Madness if Voidform is active
Cast Tentacle Slam if there will be no additional targets to DoT or upcoming movement
Cast Shadow Word: Death if the target is below 20% HP
Cast Mind Flay, interrupting as soon as anything of higher priority becomes available
voidweaver_st_priority: Cast Shadow Word: Pain to maintain Shadow Word: Pain
Maintain Vampiric Touch, either with Tentacle Slam or hard cast
Cast Shadow Word: Death if the target has an absorb shield
Cast Void Blast if Shadow Word: Madness is active or if Entropic Rift is about to expire
Spend Insanity on Shadow Word: Madness if it is not active, about to fall off, you are about to cap, or Entropic Rift is active
Cast Void Torrent to activate Entropic Rift
Cast Tentacle Slam if there will be no additional targets to DoT or upcoming movement
Cast Shadow Word: Death if the target is below 20% HP
Cast Mind Flay, interrupting as soon as anything of higher priority becomes available
rotation.aoe_note: The AoE priority is almost identical to single target: keep DoTs spread, cleave off a priority target with Tentacle Slam and Psychic Link, and press the highest value button each GCD while juggling Insanity.

cooldowns.Power Infusion: Through Twins of the Sun Priestess it can be cast on allies for the same Haste buff; find a target that consistently gets high value every 2 minutes, but always prioritize your own value first
cooldowns.Voidform: Most of its value comes from access to Void Volley during it; use on cooldown as consistently as possible so it lines up with Power Infusion, Halo and Void Torrent; extended by Sustained Potency and Ancient Madness as Archon
cooldowns.Halo: Archon keystone: deals AoE direct damage and generates resources and procs through Manifested Power and Sustained Potency; its slow ramp (Power Surge, Energy Conservation, Divine Halo) means you should use it early in the opener and cooldown sequences

rotation.hero_notes: Archon swaps in Halo at high priority right before Voidform and Power Infusion; Voidweaver replaces those slots with Void Blast, Entropic Rift management and Void Torrent. Both heroes share the Insanity, Mind Blast, Tentacle Slam and DoT maintenance core.
opener_archon: Cast Power Infusion + Use Potion of Recklessness + Any on-use trinkets
opener_voidweaver: Cast Power Infusion + Use Potion of Recklessness + Any on-use trinkets
pre_combat: Cast Power Word: Fortitude to buff yourself and your party with Stamina

gear.gearing_rules: Stat priority Haste > Mastery > Critical Strike > Versatility outweighs the value of Intellect currently, but item level upgrades still tend to pull ahead of perfectly itemized pieces. Look out for trinkets with passive stat procs and one on-use trinket. Upgrades with Mistcrests: Jan'thrazet, the Soul Fang > Venomkeeper's Horrific Cowl > Aqirbane Reliquary > trinkets such as Gebbo's Bottomless Bag. Nebulous Voidcores bonus rolls: Venomkeeper's Horrific Cowl > Jan'thrazet, the Soul Fang > Aqirbane Reliquary. Ascendant Venomstones: weapons (especially Jan'thrazet, the Soul Fang) > trinkets (especially Twisted Horror's Tendril and Freightrunner's Flask) > neck (Aqirbane Reliquary). Best embellishments: Hunter's Ritual Stone and Arcanoweave Lining.

tier_set.note: 2pc: Tentacle Slam's damage is increased by 100% and its cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds. 4pc: Tentacle Slam grants a free use of Void Volley that does not require Voidform.

stats.cheatsheet: Haste > Mastery > Critical Strike > Versatility after Intellect; identical for Archon and Voidweaver and for raid vs mythic+. Sim your character for personalized values.
notes: Haste reduces cast times, the GCD and the cooldown of most rotational abilities.
Mastery increases the effectiveness of Mastery: Shadow Weaving: more damage on targets with one or more DoTs active.
Critical Strike gives a chance for attacks to deal double damage.
Versatility increases damage and reduces damage taken.
stats.per_hero_or_mode: Identical for Archon and Voidweaver in raids and dungeons per the Wowhead stat page; generic priorities, so sim for accurate personalized values.
stats.dr_breakpoints: Diminishing returns begin above 1380 rating for Critical Strike, 1320 for Haste, 1380 for Mastery and 1620 for Versatility; above each breakpoint additional rating gives 10% less.

consumables.combat_potion: Potion of Recklessness for both raiding and Mythic+

mplus.hero_note: Archon with Misery is the recommendation for most players in mid-range dungeons; the Voidweaver build with Invoked Nightmare exists specifically for pushing the highest keys (+20s). AoE cleaves evenly off a priority target through Tentacle Slam and Psychic Link.
tips: Keep Shadow Word: Pain and Vampiric Touch spread across packs; Misery or hard casts maintain them
Cleave off a single priority target with Tentacle Slam and Psychic Link instead of retargeting
Spend Insanity on Shadow Word: Madness before it caps to keep Mastery: Shadow Weaving stacks
Use short cooldowns first and long cooldowns second so no use is wasted across the dungeon
React to Mind Devourer and Shadowy Insight procs immediately
